stageA.warmup: Original source A/B/D correct four-centimeter ruler intervals, C incorrect interval; D from1 to5 spans4 cm.
stageA.activity1: Estimate authentic classroom objects mostly5–30cm, one50–90cm. Too low/about right/too high notebook estimation then revise against real10cm benchmark, two-student discussion.
stageA.activity2: Measure SAME actual classroom objects with standard centimeter rulers, align true zero tick versus physical edge appropriately, record cm and compare earlier estimates. Iterate ruler placement on long objects.
stageA.sourceCoolDown: The Pencil teacher login restricted; first-party virtual ruler exit not claimed publisher content.
stageA.teacherOnly: Original A–D images, actual physical ruler zero, real object lengths, partner estimates and MLR2 vocabulary require human observation.
stageA.copyright: Mathematical facts source-attributed, no original publisher images reproduced.

stageB.guard: Exact original pack URL, source SHA, ordered two CCSS outcomes, prior six English fields and allowed old persisted content version.

stageC.firstPartyExamples: Mark2–17 is15 cm, 2*30+8=68cm, mark3–14 is11cm; none represent a measured real notebook.
stageC.reviewBoundary: Teacher assesses real physical objects, authentic images A-D, standard ruler zero-tick and interval lengths, MLR2 partner talk.
stageC.studentSecurity: StudentPortal authorization, adoption and published student lesson check, anti-forgery POST, max2000 chars/string, no official grading.
